description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the DataGroupDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It tests data retrieval methods related to data groups and permissions in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing DataGroupDao related data retrieval functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and creates a DataGroupDao instance.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieval and correctness of data group permissions.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of multiple data groups.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupsNoneDefined
methods.description: Ensures proper handling when no data groups are defined.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieval of individual data groups by code.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupInvalid
methods.description: Checks behavior when requesting a non-existent data group.
